none: PAS FindID 997283: Lin-7994AA: Roman nummus of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A Roman copper-alloy nummus of the House of Constantine dating to the period c. AD 330-331 (Reece period 17). VRBS ROMA reverse depicting a She-wolf suckling twins, two stars above. Mint of Trier. As RIC VII, p. 215, no. 529. Obverse description: Helmeted bust left. Obverse inscription: [VRBS ROMA]. Reverse description: She-wolf suckling twins. Diameter: 15.17 mm; Thickness: 1.64 mm; Weight: 1.74 die axis: 6
